message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported vulnerabilities from the last 24 hours passed the freshness, source-credibility, and exact component-match checks for this DLL component inventory.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. Obvious aliases and duplicate component/version entries were normalized within this file. `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-11-02 13:10 IST through 2026-11-03 13:10 IST (2026-11-02 07:40 UTC through 2026-11-03 07:40 UTC).

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities were found.

The reviewed GitHub Advisory Database results published during the window covered unrelated npm packages; no new NuGet advisory matched the monitored .NET components. Vendor and public-source checks also produced no fresh, credible exact match. Older disclosures, newly posted summaries of older disclosures, and advisories for adjacent products from the same vendor were excluded.

- [GitHub Advisory Database: NuGet](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A%3E%3D2026-11-02+ecosystem%3Anuget)
- [GitHub Advisory Database: npm](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A%3E%3D2026-11-02+ecosystem%3Anpm)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, and official integrations. MongoDB-owned alerts, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources were checked. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly published or materially updated inside this scan window; the newest MongoDB product alerts located were dated October 28, 2026, outside the window.

- [MongoDB product alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this 24-hour window. This result does not change remediation obligations for vulnerabilities disclosed before the window.
